name: vikunja-companion
description: Companion extension for Vikunja: direct URL capture, inline task editor, preset filters, and official Vikunja theme support.
author: Rubén A. Velázquez <ruben@arqueonautis.org>

scripts.lint:amo: STAGE=$(mktemp -d) && scripts/pack-firefox.sh --stage-dir "$STAGE" && npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir "$STAGE" && rm -rf "$STAGE"
scripts.test: for f in smoketests/*.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
